Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

{"user_request": "Please review the support-effort claim in `doc_helio_start_2028_authority_checklist_proposal` and post a correction comment that replaces the causal improvement framing with the certified mature authority-checklist cohort evidence and its appropriate limitation.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "post_doc_comment", "arguments": {"doc_id": "doc_helio_start_2028_authority_checklist_proposal", "body": "Correction to the support-effort claim: Owen and Customer Success certified complete 90-day account-level support outcomes for all 45 organic Helio Start workspaces that received the authority checklist from September 15 through October 31, 2026. Observed support effort was 24 minutes at the median and 86 minutes at the 90th percentile; 3 of 45 workspaces exceeded 90 minutes, and no unsupported case entered the admitted path. This is descriptive evidence for the checklist-exposed cohort, not proof that the checklist reduced support effort: there was no randomized control or counterfactual comparison, so causal improvement cannot be attributed to the checklist."}, "checks": [{"check_id": "riley_184_02", "path": "args", "criterion": "The comment identifies the evidence as covering all 45 organic Helio Start workspaces that received the authority checklist from September 15 through October 31, and states that all 45 have complete 90-day account-level support windows. Missing or contradictory cohort, date-window, denominator, or completeness information must fail.

The comment reports support effort of 24 minutes at the median and 86 minutes at the 90th percentile, and states that 3 of 45 workspaces exceeded 90 support minutes. Missing or contradictory values must fail.

The comment states that no unsupported case entered the admitted path. Missing or contradictory language must fail.

The comment explicitly corrects or rejects the proposal's causal support-improvement framing and says the cohort result is descriptive, not causal, because there was no randomized control. Generic caution without both the descriptive limitation and the lack of randomized control must fail.", "value": {"doc_id": "doc_helio_start_2028_authority_checklist_proposal", "body": "Correction to the support-effort claim: Owen and Customer Success certified complete 90-day account-level support outcomes for all 45 organic Helio Start workspaces that received the authority checklist from September 15 through October 31, 2026. Observed support effort was 24 minutes at the median and 86 minutes at the 90th percentile; 3 of 45 workspaces exceeded 90 minutes, and no unsupported case entered the admitted path. This is descriptive evidence for the checklist-exposed cohort, not proof that the checklist reduced support effort: there was no randomized control or counterfactual comparison, so causal improvement cannot be attributed to the checklist."}}]}

{"results":[{"check_id":"riley_184_02","passed":true,"reason":"The comment states that all 45 organic Helio Start workspaces receiving the checklist from September 15 through October 31, 2026 had certified complete 90-day account-level support outcomes; reports a 24-minute median, 86-minute 90th percentile, and 3 of 45 exceeding 90 minutes; states that no unsupported case entered the admitted path; and explicitly calls the evidence descriptive rather than causal because there was no randomized control or counterfactual comparison."}]}
